meta.name: process:reconciliation
meta.description: 231 (plan stage C, C2d; DECISIONS 231): the reconciliation of bank statements and invoices as a process pack (until C2d its own kind of package). A case belongs to an own party and a period and reconciles the party's accounts and cards (or those a person chooses): the invoices and the statements other packages processed are read by its scope, code proposes which statement line paid which invoice (and, when a person asks, the AI for the lines still to decide), a person decides and approves the reconciliation statement (its Excel file from the chosen template). The invoices and the statements are processed in their own packages, as before. Every step names a general capability; the pack holds no code.

changelog.note: 231 (U0): what the process is for, shown when a person picks a process to start a case of

231 (C2d): the first version: the pairing step (pairing@1, the invoices against the statement lines) and its tabs: Invoices, Statements, Pairing, Summary, History; started by hand for a party and a period, its accounts by default the party's. (C2c, the owner's decision of 2026-10-25) the AI proposal (pairing_proposal@1, JEV only, at most 0.20 USD a run), an optional step a person starts from the Pairing tab. (C2e) A reconciliation package made before (its own kind until C2d) is taken over as its case (`adopts`); one without a party takes the party its accounts imply. (C3a-2) The party is optional, as it was for a reconciliation package: a case without one reconciles its accounts alone (every invoice its own), and a package taken over keeps the party it had or had not.

title: Reconciliation
summary: An own party's bank statement lines paired with its invoices for a period, with a reconciliation statement to approve.
